content.json:
# GitHub Copilot Audit

Operational visibility for ingested GitHub Copilot audit events.

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| summarize Events=count(), UniqueEvents=dcount(EventId), DuplicateRate=round(100.0 * (1.0 - todouble(dcount(EventId)) / count()), 2)
content.title: 24-hour ingestion health

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize Events=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Audit event volume

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize Events=count() by Model, Endpoint
| top 20 by Events desc
| render barchart
content.title: Models and endpoints

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize Events=count() by UserId
| top 20 by Events desc
| render barchart
content.title: Most active users

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| extend Tools=parse_json(ToolNames)
| mv-expand ToolName=Tools to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(ToolName)
| summarize Events=count() by ToolName
| top 20 by Events desc
| render piechart
content.title: Tool usage

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize Events=count() by ParseStatus
| render piechart
content.title: Parse status

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where Message == "Audit blob processing failed"
| extend Stage=tostring(Properties.stage), ErrorType=tostring(Properties.error_type)
| summarize Failures=count() by Stage, ErrorType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Payload-safe pipeline failures

content.query:
GitHubCopilotAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize Total=count(), Unique=dcount(EventId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend DuplicateRate=round(100.0 * (1.0 - todouble(Unique) / Total), 2)
| project TimeGenerated, DuplicateRate
| render timechart
content.title: Duplicate event rate
